_what: TPO Alpha - the first agent bound to a TPO strategy. Created 2026-09-10 under the user's explicit 'create a new agent that would work well with this strategy'.

whyTheseChoices.model: z-ai/glm-5.3 is what all five existing Alpha agents run. Holding the model constant against the incumbent fleet is the point: it makes any behavioural difference attributable to the TPO report rather than to the model.
whyTheseChoices.risk_CONSERVATIVE: The strategy has zero validated edge and no backtest is possible. Conservative is the honest setting for a rung whose purpose is observation.
whyTheseChoices.outlook_REALIST: S1 emits only NEITHER verdicts and claims no direction. OPTIMIST or PESSIMIST would impose a bias the strategy itself does not carry.
whyTheseChoices.conviction_MEASURED: Conditions are advisory, not decisive. MEASURED matches an input that informs rather than commands.
whyTheseChoices.tradingConfig: OMITTED deliberately, so platform defaults apply. Supplying it requires all 9 fields and must satisfy (smallPct/100) x ceiling x floor(maxLeverage) >= max(10, minAllocationUsd). NOTE: the five incumbent agents (smallPct 1, ceiling 100, leverage 1, minAlloc 10) give 1 >= 10, which FAILS that constraint - they appear to predate it. Inventing a config would have meant inventing nine numbers and risking a refusal.

capitalExposure.verdict: NONE on two independent locks, both measured rather than assumed.
capitalExposure.lock1_strategyCannotRoute: The server said it at compile: 'every allocation is Off, so the strategy scores 0, clears no gate and will never route a trade.' minAggregateScore 0.99, zero weighted signals.
capitalExposure.lock2_noAutomation: hasActiveAssignments false, and get_agent_automation_status returns assignments: [] - verified AFTER creation, not inferred from the create response. Auto-play is a SEPARATE assignment step. The only assignable presets are MARKET_GRID 'CRYPTO WARS' and 'STOCKS OFFENSIVE', both entryFee 10 USDC.
capitalExposure.accountBalanceAtCreation: 33.563887 USDC, tradingWalletProvisioned true, mcpWagerEnabled true - the wallet is real, which is why both locks were verified first.
capitalExposure.note: balanceThresholdUsd is 25 and the balance is 33.56, so the equity floor would NOT block trading. Only the two locks above do.

correctionToAStandingRule: The memory rule read 'never bind test strategies to agents - binding is the only step with real capital'. The stated rationale is INCOMPLETE: binding alone spends nothing. The capital gate is the automation assignment (and, separately, a strategy that can actually route). Measured 2026-09-10 on STRUCT Alpha (bound, ACTIVE, assignments []) and again on this agent.
contextSourcesAllFalse: Every includeX context module is false and overlayText is empty, inherited from the strategy. So the agent sees ONLY the one custom TPO section - which is exactly the isolation wanted for rung 1.
disposition: ACTIVE, BOUND, NO automation assignment. Do not assign a preset without its own explicit authorization - that is the step that spends USDC.
